ops.text: Tentative evidence for a shrinking period has also been reported recently for TOI-8317 b (Fuenzalida et al., 2026).

A smaller rate, $|\dot{P}|=11.7\pm 2.9\,\mathrm{ms/yr}$, has recently been reported for TOI-8317 b at $P=1.06$ d (Fuenzalida et al., 2026); we do not show it in Figure 5 because it has not yet been confirmed independently, but we return to it below.
